records.text: Path-manipulation middleware must operate on chi's canonical mounted path (rctx.RoutePath), not raw r.URL.Path, so behavior is correct under Mount().
Mux.Find/Mux.Match must mirror live routing's observable context effects (including the mount wildcard-URLParam reset) when traversing mounted routes.
RoutePattern() reconstruction must not corrupt patterns that contain a literal interior wildcard segment.
RFC-defined request-header parsing must follow the grammar (tokenize on the list separator, honor q=0, trim whitespace, parse parameters, match exact coding names), not substring/Cut shortcuts.
The compressible content-type whitelist must gate compression consistently with its membership check, and its closed set must be the single source of truth for eligibility.
compressResponseWriter must not declare Content-Encoding for a body it does not actually compress.
The HTTP-method closed set must stay consistent across all three structures (methodMap, reverseMethodMap, mALL) and every consumer.
findRoute param backtracking must keep routeParams.Keys and routeParams.Values length-consistent across both unwind sites, so URLParam index reads never misalign.
Per-bug writeups are placed at quality/writeups/BUG-<id>.md.
Fix patches are placed at quality/patches/BUG-<id>-fix.patch.
Code review output is placed at quality/code_reviews/.
Spec audit outputs (auditor reports + triage) are placed at quality/spec_audits/.
Sidecar JSON results (tdd-results.json, integration-results.json, recheck-results.json) are placed at quality/results/.
Mechanical-verification artifacts (verify.py + *_cases.txt) are placed at quality/mechanical/.

quality/workspace/<name>/ is forbidden — top-level quality/<name>/ is the only canonical layout. Phase 6 gate check_no_workspace_dir fails any run with a quality/workspace/ tree present (populated OR empty).
